source: Existing workspace uploads were discovered, but no authoritative document-to-database ID mapping or human-reviewed corpus snapshot exists.
required_manual_actions: Choose non-sensitive source documents for the evaluation corpus.
Freeze exact file bytes and record sha256, stable document_id, title, license/source, and inclusion rationale.
Ingest with the production parser/chunker and export stable chunk_id, document_id, section_title, content hash, parser version, chunk_size, and chunk_overlap.
Have a human reviewer label all relevant documents and chunks for every project evaluation case.
